description: We are a passionate team of enthusiastic students interested in space exploration, technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We aim to explore creative ideas and develop meaningful solutions through the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome team members with skills in programming, web development, UI/UX design, data science, research, graphic design, and creative thinking. We believe in teamwork, learning, and turning innovative ideas into reality!
summary: AstroQuest – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational platform that introduces students to lunar exploration through an immersive 3D space mission simulation. Users can experience rocket launches, lunar landings, astronaut safety checks, lander inspections, and Moon surface exploration. The platform features crew health monitoring, oxygen and battery indicators, mission progress tracking, and interactive activities. It also incorporates NASA-related scientific information and space imagery to make learning more engaging. AstroQuest aims to simplify complex space exploration concepts, encourage scientific curiosity, develop problem-solving skills, and inspire the next generation of astronauts and space explorers.
details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational web platform designed to help users experience the challenges of a real astronaut’s mission, especially during lunar landing and post-landing operations.

The platform guides users through important astronaut activities, including confirming landing safety, checking crew health, communicating with Mission Control, inspecting the landing area, preparing the airlock, and documenting the lunar surface.

Users can explore an interactive space environment, understand mission procedures, and experience astronaut responsibilities through engaging visual simulations and interactive activities.

Our project aims to make space exploration more accessible, educational, and engaging, particularly for students and young people interested in astronomy and space science.

We incorporated NASA-related space information and data to improve the educational experience. The project combines interactive web technologies, visual simulations, and mission-based learning to create an engaging experience.

The creative aspect of our project is its hands-on approach: instead of simply reading about astronaut missions, users can actively explore and understand the different stages of a lunar mission.
